name: RelayDesk / evidence to outreach
goal: Review three synthetic accounts and prepare one grounded email draft with a launch-readiness decision.

acceptance: Assess each account against the stated ICP
Separate fit signals from unverified pain

acceptance: Phrase unknown pain as a question

tasks.outcome: Assess the approved account research and email draft; list blockers to any live pilot.
acceptance: Check claim provenance and ICP fit
List missing contact, suppression and sender checks
